ModMetaData.name: RimSynapse - Regions and Territories
ModMetaData.author: RimSynapse Team
ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.6.1 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Regions and Territories Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Regions-and-Territories/wiki
Handles mapping dynamics, including dynamic geographic province generation, world map overlays, regional faction territory control, population density mapping, road generation, and ruins placement.
Requires: Map Mode Framework
--- Changelog --- v0.6.1 - Fixed: the in-game mod list showed v0.5.2 with no 0.6.0 notes; version and changelog now agree everywhere - Roadmap updated: 0.7 is Regions and Territories compatibility (groundwork for Factions, which will require Empire) v0.6.0 - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.6.0 (Agent and Tool Foundation) - Requires Core v0.6.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged - In-game wiki guides updated; "MCP" renamed to game tools throughout
